items.originalSummary: In 2025, the United States consumed 34 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) of primary energy to deliver 14 quads of electricity sales to end users, with nearly 60% lost. The remaining 5% was lost in the course of delivering electricity across grid infrastructure to homes and businesses.
